changelog: Initial release: dedicated skill for wrapping the locally-running DeepSeek Harness Web UI (http://127.0.0.1:3080) into an Electron desktop app. Split out from deepseek-harness-windows-deploy to keep each skill tightly scoped (addresses ClawHub SDI-1). Includes minimal-shell guidance plus a full scaffolding/packaging prompt that preserves Harness plugins and extension capabilities.
summary: 把已在本地运行的 DeepSeek Harness Web UI（默认 http://127.0.0.1:3080）用 Electron 包装成桌面应用的实战指南：前置依赖、最小可运行壳、启动 Harness 与加载本地 URL 的方式、打包分发。仅覆盖桌面套壳本身；Harness 的安装 / 构建 / 排错由 deepseek-harness-windows-deploy 技能负责。
